name: arity-call-function-like/order
note: the same over-application: E_ARITY once an earlier r.f + 1 has made the solver bind f to Int, a hole (later E_TYPE) otherwise; selected-fn compiles
source: fn inc(x: Int): Int = x + 1; fn get(r: { f: a }): a = r.f; fn k(): Int = { let go = fn(r) => { let u = r.f + 1; get(r, 1) }; go({ f: 2 }) }; fn main(): Int = 0;
